confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because July is Queenstown's winter ski peak and rates vary widely by season and property. FX value comes from RBA exchange-rates results returned by search, not from opening the RBA table directly, and the 16 October figure may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of New Zealand resort towns with ski-season tourism pricing (for example Wanaka and similar alpine resort towns), converted from NZD at roughly 0.58 USD per NZD. No specific listings or booking pages were inspected.
